run_extract_projector_weights: run the glmedge-surgery script to extract multimodal projector weights from a GLM model as glm.projector
run_extract_clip_weights: run the glmedge-surgery script to extract CLIP vision model weights from a GLM model as glm.clip
run_clear_added_tokens: run the glmedge-surgery script to clear added_tokens.json for Mistral model conversion compatibility
run_extract_all_vision_weights: run the glmedge-surgery script to extract all vision adapter and CLIP weights from a GLM model
run_prepare_gguf_conversion: run the glmedge-surgery script to prepare a GLM model for LLaMA GGUF conversion
